testsuite.name: C - Lanya Faraidun - Status, dates and counts
testsuite.details: Tester: Lanya Faraidun (Member 3, C). SECJ3343 Project 1, Group TaskFlow. Baseline: TaskFlow main@5133a6c. Scope: TF-REQ-004/005/006/016/017; priority and status partitions, list transitions, summary totals, Completed rendering, optional and valid/invalid due dates, calendar boundaries, overdue rules, local-day behavior, and date formatting. Requirements cite README.md and the implementing src/ paths. Reference local day: 2026-10-27, 12:00 Asia/Baghdad (UTC+03:00); date harnesses pass this value explicitly and do not depend on the wall clock. All cases are designed/manual and remain Not Run until actually executed.

testsuite.name: TS-C1 - Priority and status partitions
testsuite.details: Valid enum choices plus invalid string, casing, type, missing and simultaneous invalid partitions. Unit harness is explicitly called out where native controls block tampering.

testcase.summary:
TC-C-001 - Accepted priority partition: Low.

Test design technique: EP - valid priority enumeration partition

Requirements: REQ-C-001
testcase.preconditions: Use a dedicated disposable Chrome profile on TaskFlow http://localhost:5173, baseline main@5133a6c. Use Asia/Baghdad (UTC+03:00) and fixed local reference 2026-10-27 12:00; for date utility/harness checks pass "2026-10-27" explicitly or construct new Date(2026, 9, 27, 12, 0, 0) under TZ=Asia/Baghdad. testcase.preconditions: Use a dedicated disposable Chrome profile on TaskFlow http://localhost:5173, baseline main@5133a6c. step.actions: Load one task "Same state fixture" with status "To Do" and record updatedAt.

step.actions: In DevTools dispatch a bubbling change event on that card's status select with its current value.
